content.value_statement: Data teams need clear charts for complex scientific, statistical, and business data. This skill guides Plotly Express, graph objects, exports, styling, and dashboards.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use Plotly Express or graph objects.
Covers scatter, line, bar, heatmap, financial, map, and 3D charts.
Shows export options for interactive HTML and static image formats.
Guides subplots, templates, colors, axes, legends, annotations, and shapes.
Documents hover templates, range sliders, buttons, dropdowns, and animations.
Introduces Dash integration for interactive web dashboards.
limitations: It does not provide datasets or validate source data quality.
Users must install Plotly and any optional export packages separately.
Static image export may require Kaleido and Chrome or Chromium.
Dash applications need separate deployment and security review.

use_cases.title: Build Research Figures
use_cases.description: Create publication-ready scientific plots with labels, legends, annotations, and export formats.

use_cases.title: Explore Business Metrics
use_cases.description: Turn tabular data into interactive charts for trends, segments, distributions, and comparisons.

use_cases.title: Prototype Dashboards
use_cases.description: Plan Plotly figures and Dash components for interactive reporting workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Chart
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Plotly Express chart for this dataset. Recommend the chart type, axis fields, labels, and hover details.

prompt_templates.title: Customize a Figure
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this Plotly chart with better colors, titles, axis formatting, legend placement, and annotations for the key insight.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multiple Views
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-panel Plotly figure that compares distributions, trends, and category differences from the same dataset.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Dashboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Plotly and Dash dashboard for this analysis goal. Include charts, filters, interactions, exports, and deployment notes.

output_examples.input: Show monthly revenue by product and region with interactive hover details.
output_examples.output: A grouped or stacked bar chart plan with month on the x-axis, revenue on the y-axis, color by product, and region filters.

output_examples.input: Compare model error distributions across three experiments.
output_examples.output: A statistical visualization recommendation using box or violin charts, optional points, shared axes, and clear experiment labels.

output_examples.input: Prepare a dashboard for geographic sales performance.
output_examples.output: A dashboard outline with a choropleth map, regional trend chart, summary metrics, hover fields, and export guidance.

best_practices: Start with Plotly Express for standard charts, then customize the returned figure when needed.
Choose chart types that match the data structure and the comparison users need to make.
Set clear labels, hover data, templates, and export options before sharing figures.
anti_patterns: Do not use complex graph objects code when Plotly Express already solves the chart need.
Do not overload a single figure with too many traces, colors, or annotations.
Do not publish dashboards without checking performance, data privacy, and deployment settings.

faq.question: Does this skill create Plotly charts from my data?
faq.answer: It helps generate and refine Plotly chart plans and Python plotting guidance based on the data fields you provide.

faq.question: When should I use Plotly Express?
faq.answer: Use Plotly Express for common charts, tidy data, quick exploration, and automatic legends or color encoding.

faq.question: When should I use graph objects?
faq.answer: Use graph objects for custom traces, mixed chart types, complex subplots, specialized charts, and precise figure control.

faq.question: Can it export static images?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance covers PNG, PDF, SVG, JPEG, and WebP exports, but static export can require Kaleido.

faq.question: Does it support dashboards?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Plotly figure guidance and introductory Dash patterns for interactive web dashboards.

faq.question: Is this only for scientific users?
faq.answer: No. It also supports business reporting, financial charts, maps, statistical summaries, and exploratory analysis.
